first_time_viewer_summary: A private reflection and peer-support concept for people facing family pressure; the film shows an illustrative, local-only workflow and proposes future Meta model integrations.
technical_evidence_status: unverified; local prepared examples and planned, unconnected integrations are explicitly disclosed
confidence: medium-low; visual coverage across the full MP4, but audio could not be heard

timestamped_strengths.evidence: A thought-check card labels the interpretation unconfirmed and offers confirmation, correction, and edit-in-my-words controls; the transcript is editable before sending.
Community discovery contrasts a broad topic with confirmed personal context, explains why a result may fit, and offers a way to change results.
The question flow previews the exact audience, alias, and wording and says the earlier private conversation is excluded.
The final slide explicitly labels Muse Spark and Muse Voice Transcribe integration as planned and not connected.

timestamped_weaknesses.evidence: The concept-demo loading card and generic 'You can start anywhere' line delay a direct statement of the user problem and product value.
Burned-in caption boxes cover portions of the interface and correction controls.
The context-matching flow is displayed as a prepared result; no model/retrieval operation or changing output is demonstrated.
The group, posts, responses, and review workflow are repeatedly labeled fictional, illustrative, or local-only; no live workflow is evidenced.
Meta models appear as future plans, without connected output or an attributable model interaction.

model_claim_accuracy.claim: Muse Spark provides future context and intent understanding / structured correctable understanding.
model_claim_accuracy.assessment: Proposed role only; the final card says the integration is planned and not connected. No model output is demonstrated.

model_claim_accuracy.claim: Muse Voice Transcribe offers optional speech-to-text reviewed before sending.
model_claim_accuracy.assessment: The interface offers an editable transcript but explicitly says voice transcription is not connected here; actual model use is not shown.

model_claim_accuracy.claim: Permissioned retrieval of approved stories with source and audience visible.
model_claim_accuracy.assessment: Conceptual architecture shown on the closing card; no retrieval operation or source-backed live output is demonstrated.

top_fixes.fix: Open with a clear user-and-problem statement before the private reflection screen; verify a first-time viewer can explain the premise within 15 seconds.
Move captions to a lower safe area and show the correctable interpretation panel unobstructed; verify legibility at mobile playback size.
Demonstrate a context correction changing surfaced results with visible sources; verify an inspectable, relevant change.
Separate illustrative community content from any real consented test flow; verify fictional posts cannot be mistaken for live activity.
Show an attributable connected Muse interaction with user review, correction, and uncertainty/failure state; verify it in the submitted build.

blockers: No connected Meta model interaction is demonstrated.
No real end-to-end backend or workflow operation is evidenced; the interface identifies examples as local and prepared.
Live community and moderation behavior cannot be verified from the film.
